messages:
kevin (CEO): Quick weekly briefing from me 1: EU Dedicated went live over the weekend. Early signals are OK but not perfect. Thanks to everyone who pushed the last mile fixes. :rocket:
kevin (CEO): This weeks focus: 1) harden EU latency and cost, 2) finalize retention changes & customer comms, 3) close Q3 Dedicated SKU definitions. Small set of priorities so we can move fast.
anya (VP Product): I'll own the customer messaging and the FAQ. Draft ready by Wed EOD, will share in #product and ping CS.
sam (VP Eng): Noticed elevated cold-starts in one AZ, pushing a hotfix to warm instances. If any canaries spike beyond 2.8s p95 we roll back. Patch rolling now.
deploy-bot: deploy "eu-dedicated-hotfix-1" initiated by sam at 1902240100. Status: rolling -> 6/8 pods updated.
sam (VP Eng): Hotfix applied across AZs. Warmers engaged. Early metric: p95 from 2.7s -> 2.05s. Watching token cost.
kevin (CEO): Great. Ops - keep extra on-call capacity today and tomorrow. CS - prepare reactive templates for customers seeing small latency blips.
tabitha (Head of Ops): Ops will extend daytime on-call to 8pm CET and enable temporary higher burst headroom. I'll coordinate with CS on customer impacts.
marta (Legal): Quick legal note: we're moving hosted logs to default 90-day retention; customers with compliance needs can opt for longer retention for an additional fee. Draft policy is with Product.
anya (VP Product): Thanks Marta. We'll include opt-in instructions in the FAQ. Also adding a banner in Console for customers who have > 180d activity.
sam (VP Eng): One more engineering note: quantized variant B's eval tranche shows a small drop on creative prompts (~1.8%). Ops savings are good but we'll keep it behind a flag until more evals complete.
kevin (CEO): Hold flags. No default switch until Product + Research sign off. Keep A/B running and expand evals.
kevin (CEO): Metrics snapshot: Hosted p95 ~420ms, p99 ~1.6s; Platform error rate 0.03% (improved); Dedicated throughput +11% QoQ. EU initial p95 ~2.05s. Cost delta vs US ~+5% after hotfix.
kevin (CEO): Headcount & hiring: engineering offers extended this week for two infra SDEs and one product PM. Thanks recruiting for the quick turnaround.
kevin (CEO): Closing ask list: Eng leads - review EU runbooks by Thu. Product/Legal - sign retention policy by Fri. Ops - publish migration window for retention next Tue. Check-in tomorrow 10:30am for leads.
anya (VP Product): Roger. Sharing retention draft in 1hr.
tabitha (Head of Ops): Posting migration schedule by EOD.
sam (VP Eng): Dashboards shared, ping me if you need access.
kevin (CEO): Thank you all. Small, focused week. Celebrate the ship but keep the tempo on stabilisation. :clap:
